list.heading: Scheduled tasks
list.subtitle: What this account's crontab runs, read from the server rather than remembered by the panel.
list.emptyDescription: Add the first entry above. It goes into this account's crontab, and the server is what runs it.
list.confirmRemove: Remove this entry? Its command file and its last run go with it.

errors.expression: That is not a schedule this server accepts. Five fields, separated by spaces: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
errors.builder: Those values are outside what the field allows.

form.commandHint: One line, run by the server as this account. It is stored exactly as typed.

errors.schedule: Fix the schedule above before saving.
errors.command: A command is one line, with no leading or trailing spaces.

environment.heading: Environment
environment.description: Values every entry in this crontab runs with, such as PATH or TZ.
environment.reservedHint: {name} is managed by the server and cannot be set here — it will be refused.
environment.reservedNote: Rename or remove the highlighted variables before saving.
environment.replaceWarning: Saving replaces the whole set: a variable removed from this list is removed from the crontab, and saving an empty list clears them all.

output.title: Last run
output.neverRan: This entry has not run yet, so there is nothing to show.
output.provenance: This is the account's own record of its runs, kept under its home directory. It is informational.

describe.monthly: On day {day} of every month at {time}

runs.heading: Run history
runs.note: Runs started by hand from the panel, newest twenty per task. Scheduled runs are under "Last run".
runs.running: Running the task as the account. This can take up to two minutes.
runs.emptyDescription: Use "Run now" on the scheduled tasks screen to run this task by hand.
runs.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filters.

limit.runtime: The run reached the two-minute limit and was stopped.
limit.output: The run printed more than 64 KiB on one stream and was stopped; its output was not kept.
